d: Any weapon. +3% weapon damage for every 10% of ammo missing from the magazine.
w: Core DPS talent. Best on high-capacity LMGs, ARs and rifles.

d: Any weapon. Killing with a critical hit grants +40% critical hit damage for 10s.
w: Pure crit-DPS gain. Pairs with any high-CHC build — the Striker/St. Elmo's staple.

d: Any weapon. +2% weapon damage for every 5m of distance to the target.
w: Strong AR / rifle DPS for ranged solo play. Easy uptime at distance.

d: Any weapon. Body shots stack bonus headshot damage onto your next headshot (up to 3 stacks).
w: Big for headshot builds — especially on full-auto where heads are hard to land. Off-build for pure crit.

d: Any weapon. +10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s of continuous fire, stacks up to 5.
w: Strong sustained crit-damage on automatics. Wants high crit chance to pay off.

d: Any weapon. Critical hits stack a +4% reload-speed bonus (max 40%).
w: Utility that keeps LMGs/ARs firing. Pairs naturally with Killer/crit builds.

d: Any weapon. Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage; using a skill (or hitting with one) grants +15% weapon damage.
w: Excellent on hybrid / skill-DPS builds. Dead weight on a pure red build.

d: Any weapon. +15% weapon damage to pulsed enemies; after 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.
w: Pulse-status synergy (pairs with Spotter / skill builds). Off-build for crit.

d: Any weapon. Killing a status-afflicted enemy grants you and allies in 15m +15% crit chance & crit damage for 20s.
w: Excellent in groups or status builds. Solo it still buffs you, but needs a status source.

d: Any weapon. +20% weapon damage to bleeding enemies; applies bleed after 4 kills.
w: Status-build synergy. Off a crit build it's filler.

d: Any weapon. +20% weapon damage to burning enemies; applies burn after 4 kills.
w: Good with fire/skill (incendiary) builds. Otherwise skip.

d: Any weapon. +20% weapon damage to blinded enemies; applies blind after 4 kills.
w: Niche — needs a blind source or the self-apply to matter.

d: Any weapon. Headshots grant +20% skill damage for 15s.
w: Skill-build only. Dead on a weapon-damage build.

d: Any weapon. Headshots boost the damage & duration of your next status effect (+50%).
w: Niche status / skill sustain.

d: Any weapon. Headshots grant +30% skill repair for 15s.
w: Healer / support skill builds only.

d: Any weapon. Kills repair 10% armour over 5s; headshot kills repair an extra 10%.
w: Handy survivability while you're gearing solo — usually dropped at full endgame DPS.

d: Any weapon. Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s (stacks to 3); kills at tier 6 grant Overcharge.
w: Strong on skill-tier builds — irrelevant to weapon-damage builds.

d: Any weapon. Grenade damage marks targets; marked enemies take +30% armour damage and move slower.
w: Niche armour-shred utility. Not a general DPS pick.

d: Any weapon. Hits stack +1% accuracy & stability; at 100 stacks consumes them to refill the mag.
w: Light utility, mostly for hard-to-control weapons. Not a damage pick.

d: All weapons. Killing a target within 7m grants +30% weapon damage for 10s.
w: Risky at high difficulty; aggressive close-range only.

d: AR / SMG / LMG. Top half of the mag = higher RPM; bottom half = +30% total weapon damage.
w: Strong sustained DPS, excellent on LMGs. Top-tier.

d: Rifles. Each headshot stacks +10% weapon damage for 5s (up to 5); headshots refresh it.
w: +50% at full stacks for headshot play. The rifle headshot-build staple.

d: Rifles / MMR / Pistols. After a headshot kill, your next shot on any enemy is a guaranteed headshot.
w: Excellent for headshot/rifle builds — turns body shots into heads to keep the chain going.

d: Assault Rifles. Every 3 reloads-from-empty doubles your base magazine size.
w: Huge AR mag pairs beautifully with Optimist. AR DPS favourite.

d: LMGs. Per 10 rounds of mag capacity, gain +3% RPM and +3% weapon damage for 5s on reload-from-empty.
w: High burst on big-mag LMGs.

d: LMGs. +18% weapon damage at the cost of -25% stability and -25% accuracy.
w: Top raw damage if you offset the downside with stability mods/attributes.

d: Rifles. Crit hits have a 50% chance to return the bullet to the mag; the returned shot hits +40% harder.
w: Niche ammo-economy/crit scaling — situational versus simpler picks.

d: Rifles / MMR / Pistols. +20% magazine capacity; missed shots from cover return to the mag.
w: Ammo-economy utility, not a damage gain.

d: Marksman Rifles. First scoped shot out of combat counts as a headshot (needs 8x+ scope).
w: PvP-leaning opener. Inconsistent and low value for PvE.

d: Pistols. Swapping away within 10s of a kill grants +30% crit chance & crit damage for 15s.
w: Good for sidearm swap-DPS rotations; pointless if you don't swap.

d: Pistols. Kills have a 70% chance to refill the magazine.
w: Light sustain for a sidearm. Niche.

d: Shotguns. Three consecutive kills refill the mag and grant +40% weapon damage for 10s.
w: Shotgun-build payoff; needs the kill streak to fire.

d: Shotguns. Each reload stacks +1% weapon damage for 10s (up to 25).
w: Ramp-up shotgun talent. Slow to build, shotgun-only.

d: SMGs. After a kill, gain +100% optimal range and accuracy for 10s.
w: Lets SMGs reach further post-kill. Utility, not raw damage.

d: SMGs. Swapping to this weapon grants +300% handling for 5s; kills refresh it.
w: Swap-build handling crutch. Very niche.

d: LMGs. Suppressing a not-yet-suppressed enemy grants +10% weapon damage for 12s (up to 4 stacks).
w: Rewards LMG suppression playstyle. Situational versus Optimist/Measured.

d: Assault Rifles. +80% stability at the cost of -35% optimal range.
w: Pure handling trade — no damage. Skip for DPS.

d: Assault Rifles. Reloading from empty grants +30% weapon handling for 10s.
w: Marginal quality-of-life. Not worth a slot.

d: Marksman Rifles. While your armour is depleted, gain +50% headshot damage for 5s.
w: Needs you to play at zero armour — too risky for general PvE.

d: Chest. Critical hits grant stacking total weapon damage.
w: The default crit-DPS chest talent. Keep every clean roll.

d: Chest. Large weapon-damage bonus while you haven't recently taken damage.
w: Outstanding for solo cover play. High uptime if you don't get tagged.

d: Chest. Bonus weapon damage to enemies within a short radius while your armour is up.
w: Strong for close/mid SMG and shotgun builds.

d: Chest. Big all-damage increase in exchange for taking much more damage.
w: Top ceiling DPS — for confident players who don't get hit. Risky solo.

d: Chest. Applying a status effect grants bonus skill damage.
w: Skill-build chest. Dead on a weapon-damage build.

d: Chest. Bonus damage to enemies marked by your skills.
w: Decent with pulse / marking skills; situational otherwise.

d: Chest. Repairs a large chunk of armour when your armour breaks.
w: Survivability — useful while gearing or in tank builds.

d: Backpack. Bonus critical hit chance and handling while in cover.
w: Excellent for cover-based solo DPS. Keep clean rolls.

d: Backpack. Bonus armour while at full armour.
w: Tank / survivability filler. Not a DPS pick.

d: Backpack. Hitting with your skill boosts weapon damage briefly.
w: Solid on hybrid builds; situational on pure red.

d: Backpack. Reloading from the ammo box grants rate of fire.
w: Pairs with Fast Hands on LMGs. Niche otherwise.

d: Backpack. Bonus armour on kill, stacking.
w: Survivability for aggressive play; fine while gearing.

d: Backpack. Cover-to-cover kills reduce skill cooldowns.
w: Skill-build sustain. Skip on weapon builds.

d: Backpack. Applying status effects grants stacking bonus armour.
w: Status / survivability synergy. Situational.

d: Backpack. Critical hits repair armour while below a health threshold.
w: Lifesaver in tight solo fights; lower priority at full gear.
